title: Perigee

basics.tagline: Mission Operations & Regulatory OS for SmallSat Fleets

listing.shortDescription: A mission operations workspace unifying spacecraft lifecycle, regulatory filings, ground-pass scheduling, flight hardware inventory, and engineering crew operations.
listing.fullDescription: Perigee is a deterministic mission operations and regulatory compliance platform for NewSpace operators and SmallSat fleets. It binds mission profiles to FCC, ITU, NOAA, and ITAR/EAR filings, predicts orbital contact windows, detects ground-station conflicts, tracks flight hardware, and connects work packages to the crews responsible for mission delivery.

cover.imageAlt: New spacecraft mission enrollment form in the Perigee mission operations platform, showing orbital parameters, mission designation, launch date, lifecycle status, and budget allocation fields.

closing.clientOverview: Perigee is designed for NewSpace mission directors, flight engineers, regulatory leads, supply-chain teams, and operations managers coordinating spacecraft from design through launch preparation and active contact operations.
closing.conclusion: Perigee replaces disconnected spreadsheets, regulatory PDFs, ground-station portals, and hardware lists with a responsive mission operations workspace. Its implemented conflict engine, pass predictor, compliance matrix, inventory controls, crew directory, Kanban board, command palette, and JSON backup flow create one dependable operational view for SmallSat missions.

features.title: Mission operations command deck
features.description: Aggregate fleet readiness, launch countdowns, ground passes, regulatory deadlines, critical tasks, and budget utilization in one view.

features.title: Regulatory filing matrix
features.description: Track FCC, ITU, NOAA, and ITAR/EAR workflows with urgency, audit history, approvals, renewals, and exhibit metadata.

features.title: Ground-pass conflict engine
features.description: Detect overlapping contact windows and antenna repointing collisions, then support rescheduling or terminal reallocation.

features.title: Orbital pass predictor
features.description: Calculate AOS, LOS, azimuth, maximum elevation, duration, and contact quality for deterministic scheduling decisions.

features.title: Flight hardware inventory
features.description: Track mission-critical components, vendors, lead times, stock thresholds, costs, and mission allocations.

features.title: Mission crew and work packages
features.description: Connect aerospace, RF, compliance, and ground-operations personnel to mission-linked Kanban work packages.

challenge.summary: SmallSat operators were coordinating regulatory timelines, ground contacts, orbital milestones, supply-chain lead times, and engineering tasks across disconnected systems.

points.title: Regulatory deadlines
points.description: FCC, ITU, NOAA, and export-control milestones could delay a mission when they were tracked in separate documents and spreadsheets.

points.title: Ground-pass collisions
points.description: Overlapping station bookings and antenna repointing buffers could result in lost telemetry and downlink windows.

points.title: Supply-chain blind spots
points.description: Long lead times for flight-critical hardware made low stock and reorder thresholds mission schedule risks.

points.title: Scattered engineering work
points.description: Crew assignments, launch checklists, and mission tasks were disconnected from the spacecraft and compliance records they supported.

solution.summary: Perigee binds mission, compliance, ground segment, inventory, and crew data through a reactive workspace with deterministic domain engines.

points.title: Deterministic pass propagation
points.description: The predictor calculates contact windows and link-quality metrics from orbital and ground-terminal parameters.

points.title: Automated conflict resolution
points.description: The scheduler checks overlap and antenna slew buffers, flags conflicts, and supports alternative-station or rescheduling actions.

points.title: Auditable filing lifecycle
points.description: Regulatory records move through drafting, review, submission, approval, rejection, and renewal states with history and exhibits.

points.title: Mission-linked inventory
points.description: Component stock, vendor reliability, lead time, unit cost, reorder thresholds, and critical mission allocations stay connected.

points.title: Operational execution board
points.description: Crew-linked work packages move through backlog, in progress, blocked, review, and done stages with mission context.

results.label: Mission operations domains

objectives: Unify spacecraft missions, milestones, budgets, and crew ownership
Track regulatory filings, deadlines, approvals, exhibits, and audit history

Manage flight hardware stock, lead times, vendors, costs, and mission allocations
